title: Tefillin Power - Yud Tes-Chof Kislev, Chag Hageulah of the Alter Rebbe

article.body:
lesson: When the Yidden needed salvation from their enemies during the Six Day War in (1967),the Rebbe introduced the tefillin campaign. "We do not need to be on the level of the Alter Rebbe for our tefillin to have the same effect," the Rebbe said. How many Yidden we can teach about this powerful mitzvah?

19-20 Kislev missions

At that moment, a great fear fell upon everyone in the (prison) room. He said,

"This is as the Gemara tells us.... "
